name: undebug_fseq
title: Clear debugging marks on a functional sequence

origin.description: Remove the debug mark from each function in a functional sequence.
origin.details: Each function in the sequence is checked. A marked function is passed to undebug. An unmarked function is left alone. The object must be a functional sequence.

translation.description: Remove the debug mark from each function in a functional sequence.
translation.details: Marks set by debug_fseq are cleared. Functions that were not marked stay unmarked. Anything that is not an FSeq raises an error containing Object is not a functional sequence.
translation.example:
from magrittr._fseq import FSeq
from magrittr.fseq import undebug_fseq
undebug_fseq(FSeq([lambda x: x]))
